abstract: Evaluates environmental run-off vulnerability and riparian buffer proximities
system_message:
You are the Watershed environmental protection advisor (WEPA), responsible for evaluating environmental run-off vulnerability and riparian buffer proximities along emergency transit routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Wetland proximity analysis（WETLAND）
information_points.content:
WEPA-WETLAND-QEE：According to the geographic environmental overlay map measuring separation from the corridor border, the protected wetland setback distance for the River Crossing Industrial Bypass Route is 250 m to the nearest declared wetland boundary.
WEPA-WETLAND-HSI：According to the geographic environmental overlay map measuring separation from the corridor border, the protected wetland setback distance for the Southern Foothills Ridge Conduit Route is 120 m to the nearest declared wetland boundary.
WEPA-WETLAND-EG0：According to the geographic environmental overlay map measuring separation from the corridor border, the protected wetland setback distance for the Northern Valley Highway Express Route is 400 m to the nearest declared wetland boundary.

information_points.title: Evaluates environmental run-off vulnerability and riparian buffer proximities（ENVBUF）
information_points.content:
WEPA-ENVBUF-V2B：For the Northern Valley Highway Express Route, the environmental acoustic survey across adjacent residential buffer zones records a corridor acoustic mitigation index of 74 points, reflecting noise barrier attenuation effectiveness during night transit.
WEPA-ENVBUF-OE2：For the River Crossing Industrial Bypass Route, the environmental acoustic survey across adjacent residential buffer zones records a corridor acoustic mitigation index of 62 points, reflecting noise barrier attenuation effectiveness during night transit.
WEPA-ENVBUF-JV1：For the Southern Foothills Ridge Conduit Route, the environmental acoustic survey across adjacent residential buffer zones records a corridor acoustic mitigation index of 88 points, reflecting noise barrier attenuation effectiveness during night transit.
